description: This file contains functions for generating kernel declarations and structures for the PyTorch code generation system, specifically handling structured and unstructured kernel functions, with support for different backends.

methods.name: torch_api_key_word_prefix
methods.description: Generates the API keyword prefix based on backend index, distinguishing in-tree and out-of-tree backends.

methods.name: gen_unstructured
methods.description: Generates declaration string for unstructured kernel functions if applicable.

methods.name: gen_structured
methods.description: Generates C++ struct definitions for structured kernel functions.

methods.name: compute_native_function_declaration
methods.description: Creates a list of kernel declarations for a group or individual native functions, handling structured and unstructured cases.
